verified_facts.text: The resort is in Harwich on Pleasant Bay, on Cape Cod.
verified_facts.excerpt: Wequassett Resort is located in Harwich on Pleasant Bay, one of the most scenic waterfront settings on Cape Cod.

verified_facts.text: Wequassett has welcomed guests for over a century.
verified_facts.excerpt: For over a century, Wequassett has been more than a resort.

verified_facts.text: Accommodations include suites, private cottages, villas and homes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests can choose from a range of accommodations, including suites, private cottages, villas, and homes.

verified_facts.text: The Cape Cod-style cottages suit families, and many have adjoining rooms and private terraces.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ideal for families or multi-generational getaways, our charming Cape Cod-style cottages offer space, warmth, and the opportunity to connect. Many feature adjoining rooms and private terraces

verified_facts.text: The villa-style buildings overlook gardens and feature classic New England architecture.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our villa-style buildings overlook lush gardens and offer a tranquil retreat. Featuring classic New England architecture and elegant interiors

verified_facts.text: The private home, The Mother Goose House, has three bedrooms, several gathering areas and coastal views.
verified_facts.excerpt: our private home – The Mother Goose House – is ideal for family stays and extended escapes. With three bedrooms, multiple gathering areas, and coastal views

verified_facts.text: Signature Suites are individually styled with coastal inspiration.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each space in our collection is individually styled with coastal inspiration and thoughtful details that invite relaxation, reflection, and connection.

verified_facts.text: Dogs are welcome, with plush beds, treats and concierge services including grooming.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dogs enjoy plush beds, gourmet treats, and concierge services including grooming and playtime.

verified_facts.text: Pets must be under 90 lbs, crated when alone, leashed, and are not allowed at pools or dining areas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pets must weigh under 90 lbs, be crated when alone, and are welcome in all outdoor spaces except pools and dining areas, but must be on a leash.

verified_facts.text: The twenty-eight Atlantic restaurant is housed in an 18th-century sea captain's home overlooking Pleasant Bay.
verified_facts.excerpt: Housed in an 18th-century sea captain’s home overlooking Pleasant Bay, this iconic setting is as breathtaking as the cuisine.

verified_facts.text: The Verandahs has a two-tiered stone terrace for alfresco fine dining, open seasonally.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Verandahs feature a two-tiered, stone-scape terrace offering alfresco fine-dining in one of New England’s most breathtaking settings.

verified_facts.text: Thoreau's is a tavern with a mahogany bar, leather seating and a fireplace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Thoreau’s offers a mahogany bar and elegant leather seating

verified_facts.text: Outer Bar overlooks the pool and beach and serves native seafood such as lobster rolls, chowders and oysters.
verified_facts.excerpt: A breezy atmosphere infuses this perennial summertime favorite overlooking the pool and beach. A creative, fresh menu offers native seafood, including juicy lobster rolls, hearty chowders and wonderfully fresh oysters.

verified_facts.text: Executive Chef James Hackney is originally from Leicestershire, England.
verified_facts.excerpt: Originally from Leicestershire, England, Hackney was inspired to begin a career in the culinary world

verified_facts.text: Private poolside cabanas offer views of Pleasant Bay.
verified_facts.excerpt: Take your luxury stay to the next level with one of our private cabanas. This oversized, poolside retreat offers spectacular views of Pleasant Bay

verified_facts.text: A boardwalk of Brazilian woods leads to the pool area's cabanas.
verified_facts.excerpt: To enter full relaxation, a boardwalk of rich, Brazilian woods leads you to the area’s

verified_facts.text: A heated lap pool reserved for adults sits in a secluded corner of the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set in a secluded corner of the resort, our adults-only heated lap pool

verified_facts.text: The main pool area has a pool and a jacuzzi.
verified_facts.excerpt: the blue ripples that dance inside our beautiful pool and jacuzzi

verified_facts.text: Guests can watch sunrises over Pleasant Bay from the pool deck.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy some of the most magnificent sunrises over Pleasant Bay from our pool deck.

verified_facts.text: In summer there is live music nightly at the Main Pool, Dive-In Movie nights and s'mores on the beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: During the Summer season, enjoy live music nightly at the Main Pool, as well as Dive-In Movie nights and S’mores on the beach.

verified_facts.text: Fire pits in an oversized circular setting are near the pool for evenings.
verified_facts.excerpt: head over to the nearby fire pits for an evening filled with laughter and great company in an oversized circular setting

verified_facts.text: The resort has three Har-Tru tennis courts and three Har-Tru pickleball courts.
verified_facts.excerpt: Wequassett’s three pristine Har-Tru tennis courts and three Har-Tru pickleball courts

verified_facts.text: On-the-water options include private whale watching, charters, fishing excursions and private boat rentals on Pleasant Bay.
verified_facts.excerpt: From private whale watching and scenic charters to fishing excursions and private boat rentals, Wequassett offers unforgettable ways to explore the natural beauty of Pleasant Bay across every season.

verified_facts.text: Activities include paddleboarding, tennis, pickleball and sailing.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dive into crisp-air coastal living with paddleboarding, tennis, pickleball, sailing, and more.

verified_facts.text: Guests can use three BMW models on property: the XM, the X7 M60i and the 740xi sedan.
verified_facts.excerpt: guests will enjoy access to three premier BMW models on property—the dynamic XM, the versatile X7 M60i, and the elegant 740xi Series sedan

verified_facts.text: The resort offers seasonal children's programs and accommodations designed for multi-generational stays.
verified_facts.excerpt: Wequassett Resort has welcomed families for generations, offering seasonal children’s programs, waterfront adventures, pools, and spacious accommodations designed for multi-generational stays.

verified_facts.text: Family experiences include bike rides along the Cape Cod Rail Trail.
verified_facts.excerpt: From scenic bike rides along the Cape Cod Rail Trail to autumn nature walks

verified_facts.text: A grand lawn and seasonal plantings roll down to Pleasant Bay at the waterfront event space.
verified_facts.excerpt: A grand lawn and lush seasonal plantings roll into Pleasant Bay

verified_facts.text: Forbes Travel Guide has awarded the resort Five Stars every year since 2016.
verified_facts.excerpt: Resort Awarded Five-Stars Every Year Since 2016

verified_facts.text: The resort has been a Conde Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Award winner since 2015.
verified_facts.excerpt: Readers’ Choice Award-Winning Hotel Since 2015

verified_facts.text: Select dining venues operate seasonally.
verified_facts.excerpt: Select dining venues operate seasonally, so hours and availability may vary throughout the year.

verified_facts.text: Reservations are recommended for twenty-eight Atlantic, especially on weekends, holidays and in summer.
verified_facts.excerpt: Reservations are recommended for twenty-eight Atlantic, particularly during weekends, holidays, and the busy summer season.
